title: NIST AI RMF MANAGE 4.1 — Post-deployment monitoring and incident response
description: The post-deployment monitoring and incident-response control within the MANAGE function of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Paraphrase pending verification against the primary NIST publication — hence 'Community' confidence.
framework_name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
control_text: Post-deployment AI system monitoring plans are implemented, including mechanisms for user feedback, appeal and override, incident response, recovery, decommissioning, and change management.

citations.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
citations.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

relationships.reason: Satisfying this control requires evidence that incident-response and decommissioning mechanisms were actually tested.
